card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space (or first digit) right before a dose amount in mg, after phrases like 'dose is', 'up to', or 'range from'. Most often seen in gabapentin dosing text.

modes.description: The blank before a dose range in a renal dosing table.

modes.label: First digit of dose
modes.description: The first digit of a dose number, before the remaining digits.
modes.example: in dosages up to <<3>>600 mg per day: i
